Task packet (thermalright-display, ~/Workspace/thermalright-display). Two `FrameSender` defects in `studio/frame_sender.py` (the helper protocol: a freshly started helper first prints a `RESOLUTION` line, then answers each frame with `OK`).
1. A helper that is respawned internally (by `_replace_process`, or by the reopen path in `_current_process` after a close) is read as if its first stdout line were the frame acknowledgment, so the startup `RESOLUTION` line is misread. Drain that line from every respawned helper before `send()` treats stdout as an acknowledgment; each new helper receives the frame exactly once.
2. A discarded helper is only signalled or dropped, so an abandoned one can sit forever holding the device lock. Every discarded process (on replacement and on `close()`) must be terminated with its death confirmed by waiting, escalating to `kill()` within a short bound when it does not exit.
Done when `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_frame_sender.py` passes from `studio/` (the environment is already installed there). Keep existing tests' assertions as they are.

mined.subject: Repair FrameSender RESOLUTION misread and unreaped helpers
